name: Freelancer

sections.daily_work: Manage your own business: find clients, deliver work, handle invoicing. Specialize in writing, design, coding, or consulting. Balance multiple projects. Market yourself continuously.
sections.learning: Self-management, time tracking and billing, contract negotiation, client communication, taxes and business registration, portfolio building, marketing and sales, project scoping.
sections.pay: Varies widely by skill and niche. Entry freelancers earn $15-$30/hour USD. Experienced freelancers $40-$100+/hour. Specialized consultants can earn $100-$200+/hour. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Build a portfolio on freelance platforms (Upwork, Fiverr), start side projects while employed, network in professional communities, cold outreach to potential clients.

try_in_real_life: Create a profile on Upwork or Fiverr for a skill you have
Complete one small freelance project for a friend or local business
Track your time on a normal day using Toggl or Clockify
Research self-employment tax basics for your country
sources: Upwork Freelance Forward reports; Freelancers Union surveys
